start.title: [TODO:de] Your Servant
start.text:
[TODO:de] Your servant lies dying.
You hear a teacher is near.

doctor_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Seek the Healer
doctor_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] No skill of Rome can save him.
Only Jesus can.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Do Not Delay
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Mercy passes through your town.
Reach him now.

seek.title: [TODO:de] Before the Teacher
seek.text:
[TODO:de] You stand before him.
A Roman among his people.

agree.title: [TODO:de] "I Will Come"
agree.text:
[TODO:de] "I will come and heal him."
He steps toward your home.

proud_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Look Within
proud_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Who are you that he should come?
Speak the truth.

faith.title: [TODO:de] Only Say the Word
faith.text:
[TODO:de] "I am not worthy."
What will you ask?

hurry_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Trust His Word
hurry_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His word alone is enough.
Speak it.

sign_consequence.title: [TODO:de] No Proof Needed
sign_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Faith does not bargain.
Speak from belief.

praise.title: [TODO:de] Such Great Faith
praise.text:
[TODO:de] He turns to the crowd amazed.
"I have not seen such faith."

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Stay Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The glory is not yours.
Bow quietly.

heal.title: [TODO:de] Healed From Afar
heal.text:
[TODO:de] You return home.
Your servant breathes deep, well.
